purpose: Wave-4 regional skilling depth for Karamja, Havenhythe, and Forinthry: first-class rows for vessel fishing, plantation, TzHaar skilling hub, volcano/edgeville/peninsula resource dungeons, calquat patch, pirate hook, Marigold Farm, spirit moths, Havenhythe canoes, Amberfell hub, Highweald/Deserted Mine mining, dark-onyx core source package, Wilderness herb/bloodwood/runite, black salamanders, and Abyss RC stack. Complements karamja/forinthry/anachronia-havenhythe packs without re-emitting Habitat, gloves, TokKul-Zo, abyss-entrance, magical-thread, or resource-dungeon package rows already present.

policy.region_rule: region_hint is primary geography. region_hints lists support pressure. required_regions + region_requirement_type=all_required only when every listed region is a hard gate. Never put multi-region/cross-region/global in region fields.
policy.duplicate_guard: Do not re-emit karamja:herblore-habitat, karamja:hardwood-grove, karamja:brimhaven-agility-arena, karamja:tokkul-zo, karamja:karamja-gloves-skilling, forinthry:abyss-entrance, forinthry:magical-thread-abyss-supply, forinthry:resource-dungeon-unlocks, forinthry:primal-ores, forinthry:charming-moths, forinthry:wilderness-agility-course, havenhythe:volatile-chinchompas, havenhythe:birdhouses, havenhythe:moonrise-dig-site, havenhythe:tear-of-inanna-hungry-like-the-wolf.
policy.no_trade_rule: Prioritise permanent tools, region-defining hubs, gather sites, and ironman supply loops that change self-sufficient progression.
policy.rate_rule: No invented XP/hour. Unlock state, costs, and effects only.

activity_additions.name: Karambwan vessel fishing

65 Fishing
Karambwan vessel (quest reward; restock 5 coins from Tiadeche's Karambwan Stall in Tai Bwo Wannai)
Raw karambwanji bait loaded into the vessel before each cast
unlocks: Karambwan fishing spots north-east Karamja / fairy ring DKP (two instances after quest)
Raw karambwan catch path for Cooking and ironman food supply
Vessel restock at Tiadeche's stall without GE dependence
activity_additions.notes: Pre-quest Lubufu spot is temporary tutorial fishing only; permanent method is post-Trio at DKP. Vessel must be filled with raw karambwanji each attempt; fish can steal bait without a catch. Distinct from Musa Point lobster dock / Stiles noting (karamja:musa-point-fishing-stiles).
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Karamja Fishing method. Fairy ring DKP is destination QoL, not a second region claim.

Source checklist after 16 March 2026 redistribution: black salamanders, Wilderness Agility Course final lap obstacle, fully felled Wilderness bloodwood, fully harvested Wilderness herb patch, Mandrith / Wilderness slayer chest
